title: Little Signals — a school for small robots
summary: Teach three tiny robot couriers to return pods, budget power, and share a garden. A five-minute offline game with a shared deterministic engine, four preserved builds, three measured improvement cycles, and exact replayable runs.
limitations: Actual deterministic automated engine runs and DOM contract tests are not evidence of human enjoyment, usability, or real browser rendering.
No browser, physical device, screen-reader, or manual keyboard-only review was performed by this workstream.
Five minutes is the 150-beat cap at two seconds per beat; planning pauses, fast steps, and early wins change wall-clock duration.
Historical builds intentionally retain their recorded failures; the second cycle's improved solo run still loses.
Robot teaching edits explicit deterministic rules, not a trained machine-learning model.
Original user-authorized game extension; no claim of completing the seed's original Mosslight Courier case, native activation, publication, or business activity.
